systems.name: 2.1 Hazard Trigger System
systems.notes: Builds on host-authoritative network model from Phase 1. Hazards are seeded from world seed to ensure deterministic generation for all clients. Start with stalactites as proof-of-concept, then layer others.

tasks.notes: Central registry that owns all active hazards; handles lifecycle across chunks.

tasks.text: Stalactite falls: ceiling entities, random timer, raycast damage
tasks.notes: Drop shadow on ground as warning. Test with multiple players nearby.

tasks.text: Lava flows: simplified cellular automaton spreading
tasks.notes: Use a tick-based spread; limit to X blocks per second for performance.

tasks.text: Cave-ins: structural integrity check, falling blocks
tasks.notes: Trigger when specific support blocks are removed. Consider a 'stress' map per chunk.

tasks.text: Dart traps: pressure plates + hidden dispenser blocks
tasks.notes: Reuse existing block placement sync; darts are simple projectiles.

tasks.text: Steam vents: periodic eruption, push & heat damage
tasks.notes: Tie into suit overheating later (2.2); visual: particle burst.

tasks.text: Multiplayer: host authoritative, hazards seeded with world
tasks.notes: Hazard activation events must be deterministic using world seed + time.

systems.name: 2.2 Suit Damage & Emergency Mechanics
systems.notes: Overheating and jamming make drilling tense. Needs network sync for jam state and recovery actions. Works independently but harmonises with hazard damage from 2.1.

tasks.text: Suit jam state: player immobile, drill disabled
tasks.notes: Visual + audio feedback; gauge redline, steam particles.

tasks.text: Unjam: player rapid-interact (wrench) or teammate coolant can
tasks.notes: Teammate interaction encourages co-op; Grub can assist later (Phase 4).

tasks.text: Network sync jam state and recovery
tasks.notes: Host manages jam timers; clients show visual effects.

systems.name: 2.3 Fossil & Coal Resource Integration
systems.notes: New block types and drops. Simple addition; will be used for suit upgrades in Phase 4 and fuel for steam engines later.
tasks: Add fossil/coal blocks to world gen
Drop items (fossil → bone meal, coal → fuel)
